title: Melodious Portal
description: A lightweight resource pack that removes the humming sound of the portal and replaces the portal entering sound effect with a more pleasant bell chime
body:
**悦耳传送门 (Melodious Portal)**

# English Description

A lightweight, atmospheric sound overhaul for Minecraft portals.

This resource pack does two simple but meaningful things:

1. Removes the low, droning hum that constantly plays around Nether portals. No more annoying buzzing when you build a portal in your base.
2. Replaces the portal travel sound – the loud, harsh noise you hear when stepping into a portal – with a soft, pleasant bell chime.

The result is a cleaner, more elegant soundscape. Traveling to the Nether feels less abrasive and more magical, like stepping through a ancient gateway rather than a buzzing machine. The pack is lightweight, compatible with most other resource packs, and works on both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition (depending on your version).

No configuration needed. Just drop it into your resource pack folder and enable it. Your ears will thank you.

---

# 中文介绍

一款轻量化、优化听觉体验的传送门音效资源包。

这个资源包只做了两件简单但很有意义的事情：

1. 移除下界传送门持续发出的低频嗡嗡声。当你在基地里建了一个传送门后，不再会被那个烦人的噪音打扰。
2. 把进入传送门时的音效——也就是你踏进传送门时那个刺耳、粗糙的声音——替换成柔和悦耳的铃铛声。

最终效果是更干净、更优雅的声音氛围。前往下界的旅程不再那么刺耳，反而多了一丝魔力，仿佛你正在穿越一座古老的传送门，而不是一台嗡嗡作响的机器。本资源包体积轻巧，兼容大多数其他资源包，支持 Java 版和基岩版（根据你的版本选择即可）。

无需任何配置，直接放入资源包文件夹并启用即可。你的耳朵会感谢你。
